[[File:ThreepioLegs-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] Versatile Humanoid Biped Unit.]]
'''Versatile Humanoid Biped Units''' were multipedal locomotion parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They were typical [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] bipedal units equipped with walking, running, and jumping ability. They were made of [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] and [[Carbon/Legends|high-carbon]] [[Steel/Legends|steel]], which allowed them to be magnetic. They had medium-to-low material durability. The Versatile Humanoid Biped Units were designed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and were part of the famous [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]], and presumably others like [[3PX-series protocol droid|3PX-series]] or [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|TC-series]].
